description: This PHP class 'EmailAddressRule' extends 'BaseRule' and provides logic for parsing email-related panel fields in SugarCRM/SuiteCRM views. It handles specific manipulations of email address fields based on view types ('DetailView' and 'EditView'), including clearing or resetting certain email field values according to pattern matches.

classes.name: EmailAddressRule
classes.description: Utility class to refine email address fields in different view panels for SugarCRM/SuiteCRM. It adjusts email field data based on view context and specific naming patterns.

methods.name: parsePanels
methods.description: Main method that modifies panels data based on view type ('DetailView' or 'EditView') by matching email-related field names and clearing or standardizing their values.
